== Summary ==
Players at a restaurant dinner during the [[2011 World Championship]] weekend in Washington, D.C. [[Chris Menzel]] posted it in reply to [[Mike Richards]]' (mr007agent) Worlds tournament report with the caption "Got a bone to pick with you", so the man in the foreground gnawing a bone is presumably Richards.

* '''Source:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=643508#p643508 Post by Shadow 14 (Chris Menzel)], "2011 Worlds Tournament Report - mr007agent", forum.starwarsccg.org (24 August 2011): "Thanks for being one of the few guys, who always still put out tourney reports. And thanks, for being Michael Richard. You rule, dude!"; attachment IMG_2069.JPG, caption "Got a bone to pick with you"
* '''Original image:''' https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=2588 (4320×3240)
* '''Image preserved copy:''' [https://web.archive.org/web/20171229080806/http://www.starwarsccg.org/forums/download/file.php?id=2588 Internet Archive]
* '''Date:''' camera timestamp 15 August 2011 04:42 (Canon IXUS 130), the night after Day 3 (14 August)
* '''Photographer:''' presumably [[Chris Menzel]], who posted it
* '''Identification:''' foreground man presumably [[Mike Richards]] (from the caption and post); the other diners are not named.
